text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Wow, the audience is so loud. And
they're all
looking at me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I see you all too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I can see every single one of your smiles!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But I couldn't have done it without
everyone
cheering me on!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... from the bottom... of my
heart!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, Rice Shower gave the
performance of her
life in the ultimate
race—a feat that's brought a
smile to
everyone's face.
